content: RTE executes certain RunnableEntity periodically If the SwcInternalBehavior of an AtomicSwComponentType requires that the RTE executes certain RunnableEntity s periodically, the description needs to define a TimingEvent with the desired period. This TimingEvent then contains a reference to the RunnableEntity that needs to be executed with this period.
